title.value: BLOOM+1: Adding Language Support to BLOOM for Zero-Shot Prompting
title.justification: This value was chosen based on the information provided in the task description, which clearly states the title of the paper as 'BLOOM+1: Adding Language Support to BLOOM for Zero-Shot Prompting'.
title.quote: BLOOM+1: Adding Language Support to BLOOM for Zero-Shot Prompting

extractions.description: The paper discusses the adaptation of the BLOOM multilingual language model to support additional languages beyond its original 46 languages. The authors apply and benchmark existing language adaptation strategies, such as adapter-based finetuning, to improve zero-shot prompting performance on eight new languages in a resource-constrained setting. The findings suggest that adapter-based finetuning is more effective than continued pretraining for large models. The paper also explores the effectiveness of different language adaptation methods and evaluates the impact on various natural language understanding tasks.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper revolves around extending the linguistic capabilities of a multilingual language model, BLOOM, and analyzing methods for language adaptation. It does not focus on climate or ecological aspects, but rather on computational linguistics and AI model adaptation.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we apply existing language adaptation strategies to BLOOM and benchmark its zero-shot prompting performance on eight new languages in a resource-constrained setting.

primary_category.quote: BLOOM (Scao et al., 2022), the largest publicly available multilingual language model to date with 176B parameters, covers only 46 natural languages...
